name: – Andrzej Halicki – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 3/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 – Adjustments in expenditure, update of revenues and other technical updates
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved the Council's position on the European Union's third amending budget for 2026. This budget adjusts the Union's income and spending for that year. It adds extra money from fines and penalty payments, brings back suspended commitments for three Hungarian cohesion programmes after reforms on the rule of law, and increases payments for regional, social and rural development. The Parliament also repeats its long-standing call for new genuine sources of income for the Union.

- Extra fines and payments raise the budget's income; higher payments go to cohesion and rural development.
- Hungary's three cohesion programmes get their suspended 2024 and 2025 commitments back.
- The Parliament's president declares the budget finally adopted; it is then published.
